notes.title: Fixed a bug in yesterday's update.
notes.content:
If you encounter an error that the Steam client could not find the executable file. Please update the game and the error will be fixed. If the update does not help, please uninstall and reinstall the game. 
Thank you for playing your games.

notes.content:
